''See also: [[Sha Miara Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sha Miara, also known as the [[Luminous Queen]], is a powerful figure and the [[Monarch]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]]. Although she publicly presents herself as an [[Underlady]] from a distant royal branch to hide her true identity, she is actually the ruler of her people. She inherited this position at the age of twelve following her mother, [[Sha Leiala]], who was forced to abdicate after sustaining injuries from a battle with plague-spirits. To maintain the illusion that her mother is still reigning, Miara utilizes a rainbow-colored [[madra]] disguise to [[The mask{{!}}mask]] her appearance. While her actual power is currently restricted to the [[Underlord]] level, she possesses immense potential and inherited abilities that make her an exceptional [[sacred artist]]. Her [[royal madra]] is characterized by its ability to manifest as shimmering [[rainbow light]], which she uses for protection, redirection of attacks, and even controlling large-scale environments like [[Ninecloud City]]. She is also associated with the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]] and has access to royal treasures such as [[the Queen]]'s Gift, a divine gem that allows others to temporarily wield her political and conceptual [[Authority{{!}}authority]]. Despite her high status and the ancestral memories she carries, she has demonstrated moments of vulnerability and desperation during major conflicts involving other [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sha Miara is a girl of ten or eleven years old with fiery red hair adorned with glistening peacock feathers. She wears a shining [[The mask{{!}}mask]] and is often sheathed in rainbows.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She is an ally of [[Reigan Shen]], with whom she works to protect [[Rosegold]]. She also followed [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She follows the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]] and possesses [[royal madra]]. Her skills include forging a sword of blinding [[rainbow light]], using a rainbow-light disguise, and utilizing her power to move citizens or block bursts of energy.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ally of Reigan Shen}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sha Miara serves as an ally to [[Reigan Shen]], working alongside him to ensure the protection of [[Rosegold]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Having been relegated to a support role behind [[The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix]], she utilizes a disguise made of [[rainbow light]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Despite possessing [[royal madra]], she followed [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]] and was subsequently sheathed in [[rainbow light]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> While she has relatives located in [[Cradle]], she appeared as a trembling lump of [[rainbow madra]] consumed by terror.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“Miara. The Ghost is dragging the Phoenix and the Titan closer to Rosegold. Help me redirect them north.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I have relatives…” Sha Miara began, then straightened herself inside her rainbow disguise and spoke more confidently. “My family is still in Cradle, and I would like to know that they are safe.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31" />}}
